thread:
jen (DevEx): heads-up — i'm going to land a tidy refactor of the prefetch / kv-snippet examples across Go/Python/TS. goal: one canonical snippet + language-specific thin wrappers. will open PR in ~30m. need 2 reviewers and a docs link check.
liam (ML): :eyes: OK. will the new snippet change the `prefetch_policy` semantics or just the example wiring? we have a couple of legacy customers relying on the old async prefetch behavior.
sam (Eng): prefer not to change semantics. if it's purely packaging + clearer comments that's fine. if we tweak defaults we should keep a migration note.
maria (Docs): agree w/ sam. also pls ensure the code examples keep the same public config names so existing permalinks don't break. i can take the doc link audit if you leave TODOs.
jen (DevEx): definitely packaging + comment cleanups only. no runtime default changes. i'll add a migration note section and an "if you relied on old behavior" snippet. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1607 (draft).
jen (DevEx): example preview (TS):
```ts
// concise prefetch + kv cache helper
const resp = await client.prefetch({
  model: 'vicuna-13b',
  inputs: ['hi', 'how are you'],
  prefetch: { max_keys: 64, ttl_ms: 60000 }
});
```
jen (DevEx): python variant will show the same `prefetch` config keys; go will be idiomatic but map to same fields.
liam (ML): can you add a tiny note about streaming + kv-cache interaction? i've seen folks confused when streaming + prefetch leads to out-of-order evictions. something like: "for streaming, prefer smaller max_keys or explicit kv pinning".
sam (Eng): +1 for that note. also please add a short snippet showing how to opt into legacy behavior: `prefetch: {legacy_async: true}` (we'll not change runtime, just show the opt).
maria (Docs): i'll run link-checker after the PR lands. jen, please add a checklist comment in the PR body with items: update TOC, update redirect, add migration snippet, run link-checker.
jen (DevEx): done — i've pushed a follow-up commit with checklist and initial migration blurb. marking the PR as draft until reviews.
docs-bot: PR opened in docs repository by jen (DevEx): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1607 — status: draft.
liam (ML): quick perf note to include in the docs: in our microbenchmarks, enabling kv-prefetch with `max_keys=32` reduced token latency variance by ~12% on short-seq workloads. i'll paste the small chart in the PR comments.
jen (DevEx): great — paste the chart + the microbenchmark commands so we can reproduce. also, can someone from eng run a quick CI link check once it leaves draft?
sam (Eng): i'll do CI link-check + snippet linting once it's ready. if any sample fails snippet-ci i'll add a fix commit.
maria (Docs): small UX ask — in the migration note use an H3: "When to keep legacy async prefetch" and include a 2-line rationale. i'll handle wording.
jen (DevEx): thanks all. aiming to request reviews in ~2h. ping me in #docs if you want me to assign specific reviewers. :shipit:
